method: Independent parse with Python standard-library html.parser.HTMLParser; pages decoded as EUC-KR; event matched by linked horse ID, date, start time, end time, and duration; read-only SQLite API18 row cross-check.
type_basis: Official page legend states 관:주로조교; all 609 classified rows have label 관 or name(관). Other labels remain unclassified.
limitations: This verifies only the six preserved official HTML sample pages and the matched event rows; it does not establish full-period availability or classify the full 280,960-row population.
The 2007-11-22 page has no exact event matches because the corresponding API18 rows have no start/end/duration timing; horse-name or horse-ID-only linkage was not treated as exact.
The 2022-12-30 ambiguous exact key was excluded from matches.
